title: Glastonbury Festival 2022
descriptionHtml:
The official artwork for the 2022 Glastonbury Festival, taken from a Stanley Donwood painting called 'Over the Levels'.
This is part of a series of works entitled 'Sacred Landscapes', inspired by field and hedgerow patterns, mysterious earthworks, standing stones, tombs, chalk figures and tumuli; the unseen forces that connect earth and sky, and the pervasive and continuing pollution of the land.

Just in case you're interested. I could go on, but I won't.


Limited Edition of 250.

11 colour hand-pulled screenprint.

Printed on St Cuthberts Mill Somerset satin 300gsm

The paper is made 6 miles from the festival.

Print size 580mm x 800mm.
Paper size 700mm x 950mm.

Numbered and signed by Stanley Donwood.
Blind-embossed with the Slowly Downward Manufactory seal.


PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS PRINT WILL NOT BE SHIPPED UNTIL AFTER THE FESTIVAL.

title: Devils Crying
descriptionHtml:
This is titled 'Devils Crying' and I think (if my memory is any good) that it was made originally with old books from the Oxfam shop in Oxford, a malfunctioning photocopier, ballpoint pens and a computer. It has now been recreated with several colours of ink, a shiny varnish and paper, and it definitely was, as it says, printed in Great Britain; an entity which appears to be crumbling as I type. We've used a metallic silver with green pigment overlaid with high gloss varnish for the bookplate motif, which nicely captures the light.


6 colour Screenprint

GF Smith Colorplan Natural 270gsm

Paper 510mm x 485mm

Print 400mm x 400mm


An edition limited to 115 prints
